résumé portfolio

NASA Library Systems Modernization

One Library. One Mission.

How I led the effort to bring ten long-established, geographically dispersed NASA libraries into a shared way of working—replacing fragmented technologies, aligning services and operations, and guiding the vendor and cost decisions behind the transformation.

Modernization Plans

A Lower-Cost Plan Expanded Library Services

The original plan, approved in 2021 and prototyped in 2022, stalled when high costs halted funding. In 2024, I developed a lower-cost plan that expanded library services and won approval to proceed.

Modernization

One Connected Library Environment

The Agency Library Portal System (ALPS) is designed to give NASA’s librarians and users one connected way to discover, request, and access library services across the agency—from research support and resource sharing to digital collections and subscribed resources.

Enterprise Website

A Digital Front Door to NASA’s Libraries

Replacing ten center-specific library sites with one enterprise website took a patron-centered effort. I led the project, collaborating with NASA library staff, users, leadership, and web developers to shape design and content around their needs and create the best experience for NASA’s research community.

Electronic Resources Audit

Finding the Access NASA Already Had

In preparation for the Alma/Primo migration, I audited NASA Langley’s journal and e-book subscriptions—confirming access rights and publisher coverage, uncovering overlooked entitlements, and standardizing records for migration.
